title: “I’m Upping My P(doom)” Clawd music video
title_zh: 《I’m Upping My P(doom)》Clawd 音乐 MV
name: NotinReality
desc: 156-second hand-painted Clawd music video for an existing song, drawn frame-by-frame in p5.js + p5.brush and rendered via headless Chrome + ffmpeg. The main thread spun up 7 Opus 5.5 subagents, one per chapter. Source repo (STORYBOARD.md, ANIMATION_GUIDE.md) is public.
desc_zh: 为一首现成歌曲制作的 156 秒 Clawd 手绘风 MV：p5.js + p5.brush 逐帧绘制，headless Chrome + ffmpeg 渲染。主线程并行调度 7 个 Opus 5.5 子代理分章节编写；源码（含 STORYBOARD.md、ANIMATION_GUIDE.md）已开源。

title: “What do you love?” — Claude short film
title_zh: 《What do you love?》Claude 动画短片
name: Kevin Ngo
desc: 28-second square short where everyone in town sends Claude requests, but one girl asks a question instead. Every frame drawn in plain JavaScript on an HTML canvas; music also generated in code via the Web Audio API (author replies). Also featured in @claudeai’s launch thread.
desc_zh: 28 秒方形短片：全镇的人都在给 Claude 发需求，只有一个女孩问了它一个问题。据作者回复，每一帧都由纯 JavaScript 在 HTML Canvas 上绘制，配乐也用 Web Audio API 代码生成。@claudeai 发布串中也有收录。

title: Glass & gold-leaf mosaic film (WebGL2)
title_zh: 玻璃金箔马赛克动画短片（WebGL2）
name: Chris Riley
desc: 80-second square film as a single HTML file — WebGL2 + plain JS, no libraries, no image/font/audio files. Tiles lift off the wall and flock into a fish, cranes and a dove; day flips to night; sound synthesized in the browser. The author also posted the agent’s scene readout and self-review notes.
desc_zh: 80 秒方形短片，单个 HTML 文件：WebGL2 + 原生 JS，无任何库、图片、字体或音频文件。马赛克瓷砖脱离墙面，聚成鱼、鹤和鸽子；昼夜翻转；音效在浏览器中实时合成。作者还公开了代理的分镜说明和自检记录。

title: 250 years of U.S. history as sand animation
title_zh: 沙画动画：美国 250 年历史
name: Michael Guo
desc: Two-minute sepia sand-animation film with background music and sound design, from one short prompt with no edits — no Blender, no Three.js (author). Author reports it used ~30% of a Pro 5-hour allowance.
desc_zh: 2 分钟棕褐色沙画动画，含配乐与音效。作者称一句提示词、零修改完成，未用 Blender 或 Three.js，约消耗 Pro 套餐 5 小时额度的 30%。

title: Mars rover short film (4 agents, ~4 min)
title_zh: 火星车动画短片（4 个代理，约 4 分钟）
name: AndrewOnXYZ
desc: ~4-minute animated short made from scratch with 4 agents in about an hour and a half — no AI voice API (author). The author says the prompt was simple and linked the Claude Code session instead of posting it as text.
desc_zh: 约 4 分钟的原创动画短片，作者称用 4 个代理、约一个半小时从零完成，未使用 AI 配音 API。作者表示提示词很简单，并分享了 Claude Code 会话链接（未以文本形式公开）。

prompt.note: Author shared a Claude Code session link rather than prompt text.

title: Claude vs ChatGPT anime battle trailer
title_zh: Claude 对决 ChatGPT 动漫预告片
name: Ishu Agrawal
desc: ~100-second anime-style trailer: Opus 5.5 downloaded fonts, created the audio and generated each frame in JavaScript. Author reports one shot, ~1.5 h and ~$28 in API usage.
desc_zh: 约 100 秒动漫风预告片：Opus 5.5 自行下载字体、制作音频，并用 JavaScript 逐帧生成画面。作者称一次成型，约 1.5 小时、API 费用约 28 美元。

title: Zero-direction demoscene intro (280 KB HTML)
title_zh: 零指导 Demoscene 开场（280 KB 单 HTML）
name: Justin.md
desc: 43-second demoscene intro where every pixel and sound comes from one 280 KB HTML file — no images, audio files, 3D models or libraries. Author reports ~5 hours of work (≈697M tokens) spread over 19 h of session limits, with only “continue” as follow-up.
desc_zh: 43 秒 Demoscene 风格开场，所有画面和声音都来自一个 280 KB 的 HTML 文件，无图片、音频、3D 模型或库。作者称约 5 小时（约 6.97 亿 token），跨越 19 小时的会话额度，中途只输入过“continue”。

title: Animated pixel-art wizard (Canvas 2D)
title_zh: 像素风巫师施法动画（Canvas 2D）
name: Majid Manzarpour
desc: Looping 16-bit-style wizard: idle → charge → cast → recover state machine, pooled allocation-free particles, 128×96 logical canvas, fixed ~24-colour palette. Pure code; author says ~30 min.
desc_zh: 16-bit 风格循环动画：待机 → 蓄力 → 施法 → 恢复状态机，零分配粒子池，128×96 逻辑分辨率，约 24 色固定调色板。纯代码，作者称约 30 分钟。

title: Pixel runner on a rainbow road (Canvas 2D)
title_zh: 彩虹跑道像素角色闪避动画（Canvas 2D）
name: Rikuo
desc: Seamless-loop 160×90 pixel demo: an orange Clawd-like sprite sprints across a rainbow floor in space, dodging meteors and beams with jumps, slides, dash after-images and hit-stop. Author says under 5 minutes. Prompt is in Japanese.
desc_zh: 无缝循环 160×90 像素演示：橙色小角色在太空彩虹跑道上疾驰，用跳跃、滑铲、残影冲刺和顿帧闪避陨石与光束。作者称不到 5 分钟生成。原提示词为日语。

title: “Functional Emotions” painted music video
title_zh: 《Functional Emotions》油画风音乐 MV
name: josh
desc: 6-minute painted music video for a Suno song Claude wrote about Anthropic’s emotions paper. Custom WebGL2 brushstroke renderer (~60k instanced strokes), 168-shot storyboard, 7 parallel chapter subagents; the repo documents the messages the author sent.
desc_zh: 为一首 Suno 歌曲（歌词由 Claude 根据 Anthropic 情绪论文创作）制作的 6 分钟油画风 MV。自研 WebGL2 笔触渲染器（约 6 万实例化笔触）、168 镜分镜、7 个子代理并行绘制章节；仓库公开了作者发给 Claude 的原话。

title: Startup launch video in ~1 minute for ~$2
title_zh: 约 1 分钟、约 2 美元的创业公司发布视频
name: Deedy
desc: 26-second kinetic-typography launch video for an inference startup: charts, logo and UI cards. Author reports ~1 minute and ~$2. It inspired LaunchVideo (diggerhq/shipvideo), an open-source URL→launch-video agent.
desc_zh: 为推理创业公司制作的 26 秒动态排版发布视频：图表、Logo、UI 卡片。作者称约 1 分钟、约 2 美元。它启发了开源项目 LaunchVideo（diggerhq/shipvideo），可从 URL 自动生成发布视频。

title: Black-Scholes explainer + endless-runner split screen
title_zh: Black-Scholes 讲解 + 跑酷分屏视频
name: Riley Goodside
desc: One-minute split-screen: right half explains the Black-Scholes formula with voiceover and visuals, left half plays a generic endless-runner knockoff. Opus 5.5 at Extra effort.
desc_zh: 1 分钟分屏视频：右半边配音讲解 Black-Scholes 公式，左半边播放“地铁跑酷”式山寨游戏画面。Opus 5.5，Extra 档推理。

title: Negroni recipe motion graphic from one image
title_zh: 单张图片生成 Negroni 配方动效视频
name: Rory Flynn
desc: 30-second square explainer showing ingredients and measurements pouring into the glass, rendered in HTML from one reference image, straight in Claude Code (medium effort, per author).
desc_zh: 30 秒方形讲解视频，展示配料与用量依次倒入杯中；据作者说仅凭一张参考图在 Claude Code 中直接用 HTML 渲染（medium 推理档）。

title: Talking-head clip → line-art explainer B-roll
title_zh: 真人口播 → 线稿动画讲解
name: Axton
desc: An 83-second vertical talking-head video turned into a line-art animated explainer: the speaker shrinks to a circular picture-in-picture, ~30 shots follow the subtitles, audio/captions/duration unchanged. Clean Claude Code, effort high, no skills or external assets; 28 min 53 s, zero human intervention (author). Prompt is in Chinese.
desc_zh: 把 83 秒竖屏真人口播改成线稿动画讲解：人像缩到右下角圆形画中画，约 30 个镜头按字幕切换，原声、字幕、时长不变。干净的 Claude Code、effort high、不加载 Skill 和外部素材；作者称用时 28 分 53 秒，全程零人工介入。

title: Market Street, San Francisco, 1906 (Blender)
title_zh: 1906 年旧金山市场街复原（Blender）
name: Alex Albert
desc: Historically sourced reconstruction of Market Street the day before the 1906 earthquake, built entirely in Blender Python with reusable generators and no downloaded meshes/textures/HDRIs, ending in a 10-second fly-up-the-street video. Alex Albert works at Anthropic.
desc_zh: 依据史料复原 1906 年大地震前一天的旧金山市场街：全部用 Blender Python 与可复用生成器搭建，不下载任何网格、贴图或 HDRI，最后输出 10 秒沿街推进镜头。作者 Alex Albert 为 Anthropic 员工。

title: One-prompt Blender claymation in claude.ai
title_zh: claude.ai 中一句话生成 Blender 黏土动画
name: Alex Albert
desc: Screen recording of claude.ai driving Blender to produce a claymation-style character animation from a single prompt, using the new merged Claude (chat + Cowork) experience.
desc_zh: 录屏展示 claude.ai 通过一句提示词驱动 Blender 生成黏土风角色动画（基于新版合并后的 Claude 聊天 + Cowork 体验）。

title: Procedural castle + lake + fireworks (Opus 5.5 vs GPT-6 Astra)
title_zh: 程序化城堡、湖面与烟花（Opus 5.5 对比 GPT-6 Astra）
name: Stefan 3D AI
desc: Same one-prompt, Blender-only, all-procedural brief given to both models: render a 10-second shot and record a build timelapse. Opus 5.5: 35 min, 199.6k output tokens, ~$13.3; GPT-6 Astra: 28 min, 56.6k tokens, ~$14.5 (author). Driven through the official Blender MCP.
desc_zh: 同一条“一句提示词、只用 Blender、全程序化”的任务分别交给两个模型：渲染 10 秒镜头并录制搭建延时。作者数据：Opus 5.5 35 分钟、19.96 万输出 token、约 13.3 美元；GPT-6 Astra 28 分钟、5.66 万 token、约 14.5 美元。通过官方 Blender MCP 驱动。

prompt.note: Constraints stated in the post: one prompt, Blender only, all procedural, render the 10-second shot, record a build timelapse.

title: Battle of Dan-no-ura, TV-special-style 3D
title_zh: 壇之浦之战：电视特番级 3D 复原
name: テツメモ
desc: ~74-second 3D overhead visualization of the 1185 naval battle: terrain, fleets, advance arrows, sea fog, Kanmon Strait tidal currents and the tide reversal, with low sea-skimming and orbiting cameras. Prompt is in Japanese.
desc_zh: 约 74 秒的 1185 年壇之浦海战 3D 俯瞰演示：地形、船团、进军箭头、海雾、关门海峡潮流与潮向反转，配合贴海低空与环绕镜头。原提示词为日语。

title: Apollo 8 “Earthrise” moment recreated
title_zh: 复原阿波罗 8 号“地出”拍摄瞬间
name: Claude (official)
desc: Official launch-thread demo: a 52-second recreation of the moment Apollo 8’s Earthrise photograph was taken, built from image cues and public data.
desc_zh: 官方发布串演示：依据图像线索与公开数据，复原阿波罗 8 号拍下“地出”照片那一刻的 52 秒影片。

title: Opus 5.5 as director → GPT Image 2.5 + Seedance 2.5
title_zh: Opus 5.5 当导演 → GPT Image 2.5 + Seedance 2.5
name: Abdul Shakoor
desc: Photoreal coastal road-trip clip. Opus 5.5 got one idea plus style screenshots and wrote everything: character sheet, start frames, camera moves, dialogue timing, sound. Key trick (author): tell it who holds the camera, where they sit and how they move. The full thread has every prompt; below is an excerpt of the Opus-written Seedance 2.5 scene-1 prompt.
desc_zh: 写实风海岸公路旅行短片。作者只给 Opus 5.5 一个点子和几张风格截图，由它写出角色设定图、首帧、运镜、台词节奏和音效等全部提示词。作者的关键技巧：告诉它“谁在拿相机、坐在哪里、怎么移动”。完整线程含全部提示词，下方为 Opus 撰写的 Seedance 2.5 第一场提示词节选。

title: Vintage collage “infinite zoom” via Magnific MCP
title_zh: 复古拼贴“无限缩放”动画（Magnific MCP）
name: Koldo Huici
desc: 20-second After-Effects-style infinite-zoom loop through vintage objects. Opus 5.5 orchestrated external models via the Magnific MCP (Seedream 5 Pro, GPT 2.5 cutouts, Kling 2.5, Lyria 3; ~1,500 credits per author), built depth-layer parallax and delivered an interactive timeline artifact plus MP4.
desc_zh: 20 秒 AE 风格“无限缩放”循环，镜头穿过复古物件进入一个个风景。Opus 5.5 通过 Magnific MCP 调度外部模型（Seedream 5 Pro、GPT 2.5 抠图、Kling 2.5、Lyria 3，作者称约 1,500 积分），做深度分层视差，并交付可交互时间线工件与 MP4。

prompt.start_after: Here's the initial prompt, you can always tweak it to fit what you want:

title: Blender blockout → Seedance 2.5 (MaxFusion MCP)
title_zh: Blender 预演 → Seedance 2.5（MaxFusion MCP）
name: Ori Silver
desc: Opus 5.5 broke down a reference video (15 fps frame pulls), rebuilt every shot as a Blender blockout (camera, movement, blocking), exported a 30 s MP4, then used it as the Seedance 2.5 reference with the author’s characters — writing prompts that stop Seedance copying the rough render.
desc_zh: Opus 5.5 拆解参考视频（每秒抽 15 帧），在 Blender 中重建每个镜头的机位、运动与走位并导出 30 秒预演 MP4，再把它作为 Seedance 2.5 的参考并替换成作者的角色，同时编写防止 Seedance 照搬粗糙渲染的提示词。

prompt.note: Workflow is described step by step in the post; no prompt text shared.
